messages.panel_description:
Abbreviations in this list are replaced automatically when you type them anywhere in Windows, followed by Space, Tab, or Enter.
Only lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9), hyphens (-) and underscores (_) are supported.
messages.error_empty: The abbreviation and the replacement text can't be empty.
messages.error_invalid: Abbreviations can only contain lowercase letters (a-z), digits (0-9), hyphens (-) and underscores (_).
messages.error_no_selection: Select an abbreviation in the list first.
